summary: Revised 10-floor boss design plan aligned with Aleph's latest commit (63e830c). Details theme-matched pixel-art sprite rendering, animated equipment, attack telegraphs, and enraged phase-2 mechanics for all 10 bosses (Warden Malakor, Archlich Vaelor, Ignis, Void-Eater Malice, Archon of Nothingness, Elyndor, Zadkiel, Sariel, Seraphel, and Oriphiel).
